proof_scope.2101: Only the range conversion from the Freudenthal theorem is proved, not Freudenthal itself.
proof_scope.2102: Finite generation and rational stable Hurewicz comparison are cited; finitely generated torsion implies finite is proved.
proof_scope.2103: Kernel/cokernel cardinality, equal mod-p dimensions, rank <= logarithmic order and logarithmic additivity proved for finite abelian groups.
proof_scope.2106: J-image theorem cited; degree and valuation examples computed locally.
proof_scope.2107: Kernel-cokernel short exact sequence derived from the stable long exact sequence. No automatic ring quotient or splitting asserted.
proof_scope.2108: Moore group-order equality derived from 2107 and finite stable stems. At p=2 the extension is not asserted to be an F_p vector space.
proof_scope.2109: Telescope group formula uses compactness of suspended spheres; periodicity explained by the cofinal tail.
proof_scope.210A: Finite independent families in a filtered colimit lifted to all sufficiently late stages; includes infinite-dimensional consequence.
proof_scope.210B: Order bound proved for the explicitly assumed finite Moore filtration; no construction of such a filtration for arbitrary finite spectra claimed.
proof_scope.210D: The Moore spectrum example is proved using K(0) and K(1) coefficients. Existence of finite chromatic type and thick-subcategory classification are cited.
proof_scope.210H: All-degree long-exact-sequence argument gives the inclusive threshold q>=b-d and finite degree window; no finiteness of input group orders asserted.
proof_scope.210O: Finite-set counting proved by biproduct matrix relations. General pi-finite counting invokes higher semiadditivity.
proof_scope.210P: Average idempotence, ring product decomposition and primitive-character complement proved by finite sums.
proof_scope.210Q: Character orthogonality and the inverse transform proved; cardinality and separation of finite abelian characters reuse 01JA.
proof_scope.210W: Only equivalence of positive liminf and eventual c*k*log(k) bound is proved. The positive liminf theorem itself is cited from the report.
proof_scope.210X: Conditional block summation proved with an explicit possible constant c/6.
proof_scope.210Y: Cumulative little-o bound proved from Burklund's cited pointwise whole-group estimate; that estimate is not reconstructed.
proof_scope.2113: J construction decoded through the orthogonal action on one-point compactification and stable translation of basepoint; Adams image calculation remains cited.

normalization_and_corrections: Separate r_p(n)=dim_Fp(pi_n/p), a_p(n)=log_p|pi_n_(p)| and S_p(k)=sum a_p(n); use only r_p<=a_p, not equality in general.
Conjecture 1.1 remains conjectural; quadratic cumulative growth is not recorded as a theorem or differentiated termwise.
Freudenthal: d>n+1 gives an isomorphism and equality gives a surjection; positive stable stems, not degree zero, are finite.

Use reduced singular homology (0BLY), not cellular chains; the nonempty-space reduced chain complex changes only C_0 to the augmentation kernel. The shared 0BLY page was edited by the parent, not by this worker.
Moore cofiber extensions are handled by finite group order, including p=2, instead of assuming an F_p-vector-space middle term.
A homogeneous quotient map is Sigma^d R -> R; the shift in the long exact sequence is retained.
Equation (8.4)'s telescope-index issue is avoided by the explicit model F[v^-1], with F=W(h-1) when using the report's notation.
Finite input means a finite degree window plus structure maps, not necessarily finite groups. The exact inclusive threshold is proved locally.
Bousfield class independence does not identify concrete telescope homotopy groups. The fixed degrees in Theorem 16.1 are tied to its chosen model; 210U states a conservative existential consequence.
Theorem A/telescope failure holds for every prime and h>=2. The p>=7 restriction of BHLS Theorem D is not imposed on it.
Height uses sup, with empty support -infinity and unbounded support infinity; the redshift page states only finite nonnegative height.
Higher semiadditive colimits, tensors and counting are taken in the local category. Pi-finite does not mean finite CW.
In the cyclotomic average, e_H evaluates to 1 on nonprimitive characters and 0 on primitive p^k characters. The primitive factor is (1-e_H)Q[G].
The single topological-generator descent formula is restricted to odd primes; the extra finite part at p=2 is not suppressed.

Theorem 16.3's published >=O(log N) is ambiguous. 210W uses only the separately printed positive liminf formula for p=2 and X=S^0. A general c*log N statement is not silently inferred from that typography.
Burklund's log-log whole-group bound gives an exp(C_0*(log n)^3) bound for log group order. Summation requires choosing a strictly larger C to obtain the displayed little-o limit.
Theorem 16.1's Levi spelling is normalized to Levy using the original BHLS author list.
The publisher Table 2 caption says prime 2 although entries and surrounding discussion concern prime 3; the table is not reproduced.
2113 defines one-point compactification locally and does not point its label at the unrelated 0F50 transversality page.
Morava K theory is not labelled an E_infinity ring. Its associative multiplication is distinguished from the commutative ring-spectrum hypothesis in redshift.
deferred: The original proofs of Freudenthal, Serre finite generation/rational comparison, Adams J image, Brown-Peterson construction, nilpotence/periodicity and Bousfield localization are not reconstructed.
No independent full proof of BCHLSY Theorems 16.1-16.3 was retrieved; the 2026 report is the source of the stated growth results. BHLS 2023 section 1.5 calls related growth applications forthcoming.
General finite-complex quantitative logarithmic window lower bounds from Theorem 16.3 are deferred pending an unambiguous original statement/proof. The local block-summation lemma is conditional.
Higher semiadditive norm construction, invertibility of higher cardinalities, faithful higher cyclotomic Galois extensions, chromatic Nullstellensatz and redshift proofs remain cited.
BHLS's full TC/THH calculations, height-two explicit counterexamples and its 100-page proof are not reconstructed from its introduction.
The report's announced Burklund-Clausen-Levy separable-closure theorem is not promoted to a locally established proof or given a new theorem page.

Detailed Morava E theory and stabilizer-group construction, higher Fourier duality, framed Pontryagin-Thom measures, rational-sphere tensor equivalence, and all individual low-stem tables are not expanded in this branch.
Full generality of cropped redshift remains open as described in the source; support redshift is not substituted for it.
Independent PDF visual/diagram verification and complete BananaSpace terminology alignment remain undone. No standalone commutative diagram was newly drawn.
